97bhrqz5.baseName: Walplus 150 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree Lush Foliage - Green - 150 cm
97bhrqz5.variantName: Walplus 150 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree Lush Foliage - Green - 150 cm
97bhrqz5.sourceDescription: This elegant Artificial Christmas Tree blends modern style with traditional charm, featuring a sleek cone shape that enhances its visual appeal. Designed to be adorned with warm white decorative LED lights, it brings festive charm to any room or terrace, creating a cozy ambiance for the Christmas season. With a theme dedicated to Christmas, this tree is suitable for various holiday settings, providing a delightful focal point for indoor or outdoor decor. Its clean lines and minimal ornamentation complement contemporary living spaces while offering a functional holiday solution for families, event hosts, and festive enthusiasts. PVC and PE Materials: This tree is crafted from premium PE and PVC materials, ensuring both durability and an authentic look. These materials are known for being flame retardant, adding a layer of safety to your holiday setup. The tree maintains a vibrant green appearance without fading, providing an evergreen display that lasts all season. The combination of these materials brings realism to your festive decorations, offering a reliable and attractive solution for annual celebrations. Decorative LED String Lights: Equipped with warm white LED string lights, this tree illuminates your space with a gentle glow. The lights come with 8 flash modes, allowing you to adjust the lighting to fit your mood—whether you’re hosting a festive gathering or enjoying a silent night in. This lighting feature also enhances the tree’s ornamental value, making it a standout piece in your holiday décor. USB Power Source: This tree includes a USB power source, offering flexibility in where it can be displayed indoors or outdoors. The USB feature eliminates the need for traditional power outlets, making setup convenient and practical. It is an ideal choice for modern homes where power access is limited, ensuring the tree can be placed almost anywhere. Versatile Room Placement: Suitable for both indoor and outdoor spaces, this tree offers a versatile solution for holiday decorating. Whether it's in a living room corner, a garden patio, or a terrace, its adaptable size complements various environments and styles. The tree acts as a festive connector among friends and families during yearly seasonal celebrations. Care and Setup Instructions: Assembly requires two individuals for easy setup following the manufacturer’s instructions. Ensure proper placement and stability of the synthetic plastic stand for an upright and secure display throughout the holiday season. Its simple assembly process allows you to focus more on enjoying the festive period. Product Specifications Colour: Green Material: PE and PVC Tree height: 150 cm Bottom diameter: 75 cm Stand size: 35 cm Durable Lifelike tips Hinged Construction for Set up Foldable Stand Number of PVC tips: 150 Number of baubles: 61 Light type: Decorative string lights Light colour: Warm white Lights length: 3000 cm Number of LEDs: 150 Distance between LEDs: 10 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Voltage: 5 V Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery contains: 1 x Christmastree 1 x Stand 1 x LED stringlight 1 x Peak 20 x 3 cm ball 21 x 4 cm ball 20 x 6 cm ball This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

mctz9wke.variantName: Charles Bentley Indoor Outdoor 60cm Pre-Lit Red Berry & Pinecone Snowy Wreath
mctz9wke.sourceDescription: Welcome guests in festive style with our indoor outdoor 60cm pre-lit red berry & pinecone snowy wreath, a timeless Christmas decoration perfect for any front door or festive display. Lightly dusted with a snowy finish, and adorned with vibrant red berries & pinecones, our pre-lit wreath brings a touch of winter wonder to any space. Warm white Micro LED lights are woven throughout the frosted greenery, casting a soft, magical glow that's perfect for creating a cosy, inviting atmosphere. Battery powered for easy placement, this wreath is ideal for both indoor and sheltered outdoor use – decorate doors, windows, mantels, or walls with ease. Whether you're refreshing your holiday décor or starting a new tradition, this elegant wreath is designed to bring festive charm to your home year after year. Please Note: The branches may need to be fanned out by hand after assembly to achieve the desired look.
